title: CrowdWorks: send still-open GO proposals NOW under PG-2 (13521885 apply-by 10/11, 13513520 apply-by 10/12) after re-checking each job
detail: Owner granted PG-2 (ops/2026-10/PERMISSIONS.md) on 2026-10-11: send qualifying CrowdWorks proposals WITHOUT owner confirmation. Headless, dedicated crowdworks-profile only. RE-CHECK FIRST on the job page: still 募集中, apply-by not passed, budget/scope/deadline/conditions unchanged vs the screen, applicant count, no new 'AI不可'/track-record/external-contact requirement. Then check PG-2 conditions 1-8; if all hold, fill and SUBMIT the 応募 form (price incl. tax as in the draft, 完了予定日 with ≥2 days buffer). Also re-check any other GO in crowdworks-2026-10-09.md still open. Do NOT send 13513659/13521406 (re-posted ¥15k PDF→Word text, lure pattern). Log each: event proposal_sent --grant PG-2 --request <url> --price <yen> --days <n> --conditions '1..8 ok: ...' + signal proposal_sent 1 --channel crowdworks. If a job closed or changed: log one line why not sent. If the auto-mode classifier still blocks submission despite PG-2 in your prompt: do NOT work around it; release --blocked-by owner-crowdworks-classifier-allow and say exactly which tool call was blocked.
acceptance: each listed job: sent (with PG-2 record) or a one-line reason; still-open GO count recorded in the screen file
